<DESCRIPTION>EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT, DATED FEBRUARY 13, 2024, BY AND BETWEEN QUALSTAR CORPORATION AND STEVEN N. BRONSON
<TEXT>

<BODY>
<DIV style=margin-left:72pt;width:468pt><P align=right style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><B>Exhibit 10.1</B></P>
<HR style='border:0;height:0;width:0;margin:14pt 0 0 0'><P align=center style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT</B></FONT></P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt;text-indent:36pt'>This <B>EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT</B> (this &#8220;<B><I>Agreement</I></B>&#8221;), entered into on February 13, 2024 (&#8220;<B><I>Execution Date</I></B>&#8221;) and effective as of February 1, 2024 (&#8220;<B><I>Effective Date</I></B>&#8221;), is by and between Qualstar Corporation, a California corporation (the &#8220;<B><I>Company</I></B>&#8221;) and Steven N. Bronson, an individual (&#8220;<B><I>Executive</I></B>,&#8221; and together with the Company, the &#8220;<B><I>Parties</I></B>,&#8221; and each a &#8220;<B><I>Party</I></B>&#8221;). </P>
<P align=center style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>W I T N E S </B><B>S</B><B> E T </B><B>H</B></FONT> :</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt;text-indent:72pt'><B>WHEREAS</B>, the Company desires to continue to employ Executive and Executive is willing to continue to be employed on such terms and conditions as set forth below. </P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt;text-indent:72pt'><B>NOW, THEREFORE</B>, in consideration of the mutual covenants, promises, and obligations set forth herein, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties hereto, intending to be legally bound hereby, agree as follows:</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:36pt'>1.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:72pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Employment</B></FONT>. &nbsp;The Company hereby employs Executive as its Chief Executive Officer and President, subject to the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:36pt'>2.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:72pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Term</B></FONT>. &nbsp;The term of this Agreement shall commence effective as of the Effective Date and terminate on January 31, 2026 (the &#8220;<B><I>Term</I></B>&#8221;), subject to earlier termination pursuant to the provisions herein. &nbsp;If Executive&#8217;s employment has not been sooner terminated, this Agreement shall end automatically upon expiration of the Term.  If Executive continues to provide services to the Company following expiration of the Term without having entered into a new written employment agreement or written amendment to this Agreement extending Executive&#8217;s employment hereunder, Executive&#8217;s continued employment shall be &#8220;at will,&#8221; which means that Executive and the Company shall thereafter each be free to terminate the employment relationship at any time for any reason or for no reason, with or without cause and with or without advance notice.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:36pt'>3.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:72pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Duties and Location</B></FONT>. &nbsp;Executive shall serve as Chief Executive Officer and President and shall perform all duties commensurate with his positions and as may be assigned to him by the Board of Directors of the Company (the &#8220;<B><I>Board</I></B>&#8221;). &nbsp;It is understood that Executive shall not be required to devote his full business time and energies to the business and affairs of the Company, however Executive shall use his best efforts, skills and abilities to perform all duties and obligations required of him by the Company, promote the interests of the Company and diligently and competently perform the duties of his positions for the Company. &nbsp;Executive&#160;will be based in Los Angeles, California or Seattle, Washington, but will travel as necessary to fulfill his duties and responsibilities. Executive is eligible for reimbursement of related and necessary office and travel expenses consistent with <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Section 5</FONT>.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:36pt'>4.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:72pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Compensation and Benefits</B></FONT>.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>4.1.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Base Salary</B></FONT>. &nbsp;During the Term, as compensation for the satisfactory performance of all duties to be performed by Executive hereunder, the Company shall pay Executive a base salary of $250,000 per annum (the &#8220;<B><I>Base Salary</I></B>&#8221;), to be paid in accordance with the Company&#8217;s usual payroll policies and practices less required deductions for state and federal &nbsp;</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#909090;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'>withholding tax, Social Security, and any other applicable employee benefit contributions and taxes.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>4.2.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Bonus Compensation</B></FONT>. &nbsp;Executive shall be eligible to earn up to fifty percent (50%) of his Base Salary for each calendar year during the Term (the &#8220;<B><I>Bonus Payment</I></B>&#8221;), in the form of a bonus based on the Company&#8217;s achievement of financial objectives established by the Board and the Executive&#8217;s achievement of agreed-to personal business objectives. &nbsp;Whether Executive earns a bonus for an applicable calendar year will be determined solely in the discretion of the Board. Any such bonus shall not be earned by or vest in Executive until the date such amount, if any, is determined by the Board. &nbsp;If earned, the amount earned shall be paid within thirty (30) calendar days of the date that the bonus vests in Executive.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>4.3.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Stock Option Grant</B></FONT>.  Subject to the approval by the Board, the Company shall grant to Executive the option to purchase up to 100,000 shares (the &#8220;<B><I>Option</I></B>&#8221;) of the Company&#8217;s Common Stock (&#8220;<B><I>Common Stock</I></B>&#8221;). <A name=_Hlk157426113 />The exercise price per share of the Common Stock underlying the Option shall be equal to the closing sales price per share of the Common Stock as quoted on the Over-The-Counter markets, or applicable trading market, as reported by a reliable reporting service on the close of business on the date of grant. The Option (including the distribution of any shares of the Common Stock issuable pursuant thereto) shall be granted under and shall be subject to the terms of a non-qualified stock option agreement and a related notice of stock option grant in a form acceptable to the Board (the &#8220;<B><I>Option Agreement</I></B>&#8221;), which Option Agreement shall provide that <A name=_Hlk157427035 />50,000 shares of Common Stock underlying the Option shall vest twelve (12) months following the Effective Date and the remaining 50,000 shares of Common Stock underlying the Option shall vest twenty-four (24) months following the Effective Date.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>4.4.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Paid Time Off</B></FONT>. &nbsp;Executive shall accrue Paid Time Off (PTO) on a pro-rated basis at the rate of five weeks (200 hours) per year, up to a maximum of 300 hours that may be accrued. After the maximum accrual is met, Executive will not accrue additional PTO until he uses PTO and brings the balance below the maximum accrual. &nbsp;This PTO allowance shall be in addition to the paid holidays that are provided as part of the standard benefit package for all the Company employees.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>4.5.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Benefit Package</B></FONT>. &nbsp;Executive shall be eligible to receive any benefit and participate in any benefit plan generally available to officers of the Company, subject only to any waiting-time period or other requirement set forth in the applicable plan. Nothing in this Agreement shall preclude the Company from terminating or amending any employee benefit plan or program from time to time.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>4.6.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Relocation Allowance</B></FONT>. &nbsp;If the Company relocates some or part of its administrative offices from Southern California to the Seattle, WA area, the Company shall reimburse Executive for 50% of his documented expenses in moving to the Seattle, WA area, including expenses for the physical transport of Executive&#8217;s household and personal items, including vehicles, and travel fees. &nbsp;In addition, the Company shall reimburse Executive for 100% of the monthly lease amount for Executive&#8217;s primary residence in Southern California for a number of months equal to 50% of the number of whole months remaining on Executive&#8217;s then-current lease, not to exceed three months.&nbsp;</P>
<HR style='border:0;height:0;width:0;margin:14pt 0 0 0'><P align=center style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>2</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#909090;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:36pt'>5.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:72pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Reimbursement of Business Expenses</B></FONT>. &nbsp;During the Term, upon submission of proper invoices, receipts or other supporting documentation satisfactory to the Company and in specific accordance with such guidelines as may be established from time to time, Executive shall be reimbursed by the Company for all reasonable business expenses actually and necessarily incurred by Executive on behalf of the Company in connection with Executive&#8217;s performance of services under this Agreement.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:36pt'>6.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:72pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Representations as to Employability</B></FONT>. &nbsp;&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>6.1.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Absence of prior restrictions</B></FONT>. &nbsp;Executive represents and warrants that Executive is not party to, or bound by, any agreement or commitment, or subject to any restriction, including, but not limited to agreements related to previous employment containing confidentiality, non-solicitation, non-poaching or non-compete covenants, which would adversely affect the business of the Company or Executive&#8217;s performance of duties under this Agreement. &nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>6.2.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Absence of </B><B>third-party</B><B> proprietary information</B></FONT>. Executive represents and warrants that Executive is not in possession of and will not bring onto the Company&#8217;s premises or access or utilize any proprietary information of any prior employer or other third-party that Executive is not permitted to have. &nbsp;Executive represents, further, that Executive will be able to fulfill Executive&#8217;s duties hereunder without such proprietary information by utilizing only information that is generally available in the public domain or the rightful property of Executive or the Company. &nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:36pt'>7.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:72pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Confidentiality and Proprietary Information</B></FONT>. &nbsp;&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>7.1.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Non-Disclosure</B></FONT>. &nbsp;During the course of Executive&#8217;s employment with the Company, Executive has and will continue to learn of Confidential Information (as defined below) and Executive may develop Confidential Information on behalf of the Company. &nbsp;Executive agrees that Executive will not use or disclose to any person (except as required by applicable law or for the proper performance of Executive&#8217;s duties and responsibilities for the Company) any Confidential Information obtained or created by Executive incident to Executive&#8217;s employment or any other association with the Company. &nbsp;Executive understands that this restriction shall continue to apply after Executive&#8217;s employment terminates, regardless of the reason for such termination.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>7.2.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Protection of Information</B></FONT>. &nbsp;All information, trade secrets, data, documents, records and files, in any kind of media, relating to the business (whether past, present or future) of the Company (&#8220;<B><I>Confidential Information</I></B>&#8221;), whether or not prepared by Executive, shall be the sole and exclusive property of the Company. &nbsp;Executive agrees to safeguard all Confidential Information and to surrender to the Company, at the time Executive&#8217;s employment terminates or at such earlier time as requested, all tangible forms of Confidential Information of the Company then in Executive&#8217;s possession or control, and to destroy or retrieve any copies, such that no Confidential Information which was at any time in Executive&#8217;s possession or control will exist in tangible form other than what Executive has turned over to the Company or destroyed. Notwithstanding any other provisions of this Agreement, pursuant to 18 USC &#167;&nbsp;1833(b), Executive will not be held criminally or civilly liable under any federal or state trade secret law for the disclosure of a trade secret that is made: (i) solely for the purpose of reporting or investigating a suspected violation of law and in confidence to a federal, state, or local government official (either &nbsp;</P>
<HR style='border:0;height:0;width:0;margin:14pt 0 0 0'><P align=center style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>3</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#909090;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'>directly or indirectly) or to an attorney; or (ii) in a complaint or other document filed in a lawsuit or other proceeding, if such filing is made under seal.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:36pt'>8.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:72pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Application of IRC Section 409A</B></FONT>. &nbsp;&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>8.1.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD>If Executive is a &#8220;specified employee&#8221; within the meaning of the Internal Revenue Code (&#8220;<B><I>IRC</I></B>&#8221;) Section 409A(a)(2)(B)(i) at the time of termination of employment, any payments and benefits provided under this Agreement that constitute &#8220;nonqualified deferred compensation&#8221; subject to IRC Section 409A that are provided to the Executive on account of his separation from service and are otherwise payable during the period ending on the date that is six (6) months after the separation from service shall be paid in a lump sum on the date that is six (6) months after Executive&#8217;s separation from service instead of the date on which it would otherwise be paid to the extent required by IRC Section 409A.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>8.2.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD>To the extent applicable, it is intended that this Agreement comply with the provisions of IRC Section 409A, so as to prevent inclusion in gross income of any amounts payable or benefits provided hereunder in a taxable year that is prior to the taxable year or years in which such amounts or benefits would otherwise actually be distributed, provided or otherwise made available to Executive. &nbsp;This Agreement shall be construed, administered, and governed in a manner consistent with this intent and the following provisions of this paragraph shall control over any contrary provisions of this Agreement.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>8.3.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD>Payments and benefits under this Agreement payable upon Executive&#8217;s termination or severance of employment with the Company that constitute deferred compensation under IRC Section 409A shall not be paid or provided prior to Executive&#8217;s &#8220;separation from service&#8221; within the meaning of IRC Section 409A.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>8.4.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD>For purposes of IRC Section 409A, the right to a series of installment payments under this Agreement shall be treated as a right to a series of separate payments so that each payment is designated as a separate payment for purposes of IRC Section 409A.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>8.5.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD>References in this Agreement to IRC Section 409A include both that Section of the IRC itself and any guidance promulgated thereunder.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>8.6.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD>the Company makes no representation or warranty and shall have no liability to Executive or any other person if any provisions of this Agreement are determined to constitute deferred compensation subject to IRC Section 409A but do not satisfy an exemption from, or the conditions of, such Section.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:36pt'>9.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:72pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Termination</B></FONT>. &nbsp;This Agreement may be terminated prior to the expiration of the Term set forth in <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Section 2</FONT> upon the occurrence of any of the events set forth in, and subject to the terms of, this <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Section 9</FONT>.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>9.1.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Voluntarily</B></FONT>. &nbsp;Executive may terminate this Agreement at any time by giving no less than ninety (90) days written notice to the Company.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>9.2.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Death</B></FONT>. &nbsp;This Agreement will terminate immediately and automatically upon Executive&#8217;s death. &nbsp;&nbsp;</P>
<HR style='border:0;height:0;width:0;margin:14pt 0 0 0'><P align=center style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>4</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#909090;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>9.3.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Disability</B></FONT>. &nbsp;The Company may terminate this Agreement immediately upon providing Executive with written notice of termination for disability at any time after Executive has been unable to perform the essential duties of his job for more than ninety (90) consecutive days or for more than one hundred twenty (120) days in any calendar year due to a physical or mental disability, even when Executive has been provided with such reasonable accommodation as the Company can provide without undue hardship. &nbsp;&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt;color:#000000'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>9.4.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Termination by </B><B>the Company</B><B> for Cause</B></FONT>. &nbsp;The Company may terminate Executive&#8217;s employment at any time for Cause.<FONT style=font-size:11pt> </FONT>For purposes of this Agreement, &#8220;<B><I>Cause</I></B>&#8221; for termination shall exist if Executive engages in any of the following conduct: &nbsp;(a) Executive willfully breaches or habitually neglects his duties; (b) Executive habitually fails to comply with any of the Company&#8217;s policies or procedures, or deliberately interferes with such compliance by any other employee of the Company; (c) Executive engages in misconduct or commits any act in connection with his employment which, in the subjective judgment of the Company, causes injury to the Company, its reputation or business relationships; (d) Executive abandons or purports to resign his employment with the Company prior to the expiration of the Term; (e) Executive is convicted of or pleads no contest to any felony, any crime of moral turpitude or any crime which, in the subjective judgment of the Company, adversely affects the Company, its reputation or business relationships; or (f) Executive otherwise breaches any material provision of this Agreement. &nbsp;Notwithstanding the foregoing, before any termination pursuant to Sections <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>9.4(a)</FONT>, <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>(b)</FONT> or <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>(f)</FONT> shall become effective, the Company shall provide Executive with written notice of its intent to terminate Executive based on the applicable subsection (&#8220;<B><I>Notice</I></B>&#8221;), and Executive shall be granted a one-time opportunity to cure such conduct within twenty (20) days after receiving such Notice.  &nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>9.5.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Termination by Executive for Good Reason</B></FONT>. &nbsp;Executive may terminate his employment by written notice to the Company for Good Reason (as defined herein). &#8220;<B><I>Good Reason</I></B>&#8221;<I> </I>means one or more of the following: (a) Executive&#8217;s assignment by the Company, without Executive&#8217;s written consent, to duties or responsibilities which are not materially consistent with that of duties and responsibilities as set forth herein; (b) material reduction by the Company, without Executive&#8217;s written consent, of Executive&#8217;s Base Salary and any Bonus Payment pursuant to <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Section 4.1</FONT> and <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Section 4.2</FONT>, above; or (c) the Company&#8217;s material breach of its obligations under this Agreement, which breach has continued uncured for a period of twenty (20) days after the Company&#8217;s receipt of written notice from Executive.<A name=_DV_M27 />  &nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt;color:#000000'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>9.6.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Termination by </B><B>the Company </B><B>Without Cause</B></FONT>. &nbsp;The Company may terminate this Agreement without Cause effective immediately, subject to the payment obligations in <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Sections 9.7</FONT> or <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>10</FONT>, if applicable.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>9.7.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Compensation in Event of Termination</B></FONT>. &nbsp;&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:108pt'>a.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:144pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Voluntary Termination</B></FONT>. &nbsp;Upon Executive&#8217;s voluntary termination of this Agreement pursuant to <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Section 9.1</FONT>, the Company&#8217;s only obligation to Executive shall be (1) to pay Executive any salary earned on or before the Executive&#8217;s last day of employment less deductions for any applicable state and federal withholding taxes, regardless of the reason (&#8220;<B><I>Separation Date</I></B>&#8221;), (2) reimburse Executive for any reimbursable expenses properly incurred by Executive through and including the Separation Date, and (3)&#160;pay Executive for any unused &nbsp;</P>
<HR style='border:0;height:0;width:0;margin:14pt 0 0 0'><P align=center style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>5</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#909090;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'>vacation Executive has accrued as of the Separation Date (collectively, the &#8220;<B><I>Final Pay</I></B>&#8221;).  Executive shall retain vested benefits, if any exist, which vested benefits will be handled in accordance with their controlling documents. &nbsp;All further vesting shall cease on the date of termination.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:108pt'>b.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:144pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Termination for Death or Disability</B></FONT>. &nbsp;If Executive&#8217;s employment is  terminated due to Executive&#8217;s Death or Disability pursuant to <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Sections 9.2</FONT> or <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>9.3</FONT>, then Executive or his beneficiaries will be entitled to receive the Final Pay and all equity, including the Option, issued to Executive by the Company but not yet vested as of the Separation Date shall immediately fully vest and become exercisable and/or earned as of the Separation Date, provided that, Executive satisfies the conditions for Severance in <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Section 9.7(d)</FONT>.  In addition, the Company shall pay to Executive a pro-rated portion of any Bonus Payment pursuant to <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Section 4.2</FONT> (pro-rated to reflect the portion of the applicable calendar year Executive worked prior to the ending of Executive&#8217;s employment). &nbsp;Except as provided in this <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Section 9.7(b)</FONT>, upon termination pursuant to <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Sections 9.2</FONT> or <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>9.3</FONT>, Executive will not be entitled to any further compensation or payments.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:108pt'>c.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:144pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Termination for Cause</B></FONT>. &nbsp;Upon the termination of this Agreement pursuant to <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Section 9.4</FONT>, Executive shall be entitled to receive the Final Pay. If the Company terminates Executive&#8217;s employment pursuant to <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Section 9.4</FONT>, all compensation described in this Agreement will cease as of the Separation Date, and Executive will have no rights to any other compensation or payments other than the Final Pay.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:108pt'>d.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:144pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Termination by Executive for Good Reason or by </B><B>the Company </B><B>Without Cause</B></FONT>. &nbsp;If Executive&#8217;s employment is terminated by Executive for Good Reason pursuant to <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Section 9.5</FONT>, or by the Company without Cause pursuant to <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Section 9.6</FONT>, then Executive will be entitled to receive the Final Pay. &nbsp;In addition, if Executive&#8217;s employment is terminated by Executive for Good Reason pursuant to <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Section 9.5</FONT>, or by the Company without Cause pursuant to <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Section 9.6</FONT>, then Executive will be entitled to receive the following (collectively, the &#8220;<B><I>Severance</I></B>&#8221;), subject to the conditions specified below: &nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-left:90pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Wingdings;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Wingdings>&#167;</FONT></KBD>a severance payment equal to twelve (12) months of Executive&#8217;s Base Salary in lieu of Executive&#8217;s Base Salary that would otherwise be payable to Executive for the duration of the Term following the Separation Date; &nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-left:90pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Wingdings;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Wingdings>&#167;</FONT></KBD>a pro-rated portion of the Bonus Payment pursuant to <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Section 4.2</FONT> (pro-rated to reflect the portion of the applicable calendar year Executive worked prior to the ending of Executive&#8217;s employment); &nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-left:90pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Wingdings;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Wingdings>&#167;</FONT></KBD>COBRA Benefits (as defined below); and&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-left:90pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Wingdings;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Wingdings>&#167;</FONT></KBD>all equity awards, including the Option, issued to Executive by the Company but not yet vested as of the Separation Date shall immediately fully vest and become exercisable and/or earned. &nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'>Severance is expressly conditioned upon (1) Executive&#8217;s execution and delivery to the Company of a separation agreement in a form acceptable to the Company, which will include a full waiver and release of all claims by Executive against the Company, its affiliates, and their officers, directors, employees, and agents; (2)&#160;Executive not rescinding or revoking the separation </P>
<HR style='border:0;height:0;width:0;margin:14pt 0 0 0'><P align=center style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>6</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#909090;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'>agreement; and (3) Executive being and remaining in full compliance with this Agreement and all other obligations to the Company. Except as provided in this <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Section 9.7(d)</FONT>, if Executive&#8217;s employment is terminated by Executive for Good Reason pursuant to <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Section 9.5</FONT> or by the Company without Cause pursuant to <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Section 9.6</FONT>, Executive will not be entitled to any further compensation, payments, or severance.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'>For purposes of this section, &#8220;<B><I>COBRA Benefits</I></B>&#8221; mean if Executive timely elects continued coverage under COBRA, the Company will pay Executive&#8217;s COBRA premiums to continue Executive&#8217;s coverage (including coverage for eligible dependents, if currently provided) at the same level of employer contribution as is currently provided (&#8220;<B><I>COBRA Premiums</I></B>&#8221;) for the 12-month period following the separation date (the &#8220;<B><I>COBRA Premium Period</I></B>&#8221;); provided, however, that the Company will cease to pay the COBRA Premiums if: (A) Executive becomes eligible for comparable and comparably paid group health insurance coverage through a new employer, or (B) Executive and Executive&#8217;s covered eligible dependents ceases to be eligible for COBRA continuation coverage. &nbsp;Notwithstanding the foregoing, if the Company determines, in its sole discretion, that it cannot pay the COBRA Premiums without a substantial risk of violating applicable law (including, without limitation, Section 2716 of the Public Health Service Act), the Company instead shall pay to Executive, on the first day of each month, a fully taxable cash payment equal to the applicable COBRA premiums for that month, subject to applicable tax withholdings (such amount, the &#8220;<B><I>Special Cash Payment</I></B>&#8221;), for the remainder of the COBRA Premium Period (or such shorter period if Executive otherwise becomes covered by another employer&#8217;s group health plan ). &nbsp;In the event Executive becomes covered under another employer&#8217;s comparable and comparably paid group health plan during the COBRA Premium Period, Executive must immediately notify the Company of such event and the Company shall cease payment of the COBRA Premiums or the Special Cash Payments as the case may be.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:36pt'>10.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:72pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Change In Control Provision</B></FONT>.  In the event there occurs a Change in Control with respect to the Company that results in the termination of Executive&#8217;s employment for Good Reason or without Cause within one hundred eighty (180) days after the effective date of the Change in Control and subject to the conditions specified below, then Executive shall be entitled to receive the compensation, payments and Severance set forth in <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Section 9.7(d)</FONT>. &nbsp;For the purposes of this Section, &#8220;<B><I>Change In Control</I></B>&#8221; means the consummation of any of the following transactions effecting a change in ownership or control of the Company: (i)&#160;a merger, consolidation or reorganization, <I>unless</I> securities representing more than fifty percent (50%) of the total combined voting power of the voting securities of the successor corporation are immediately thereafter beneficially owned, directly or indirectly and in substantially the same proportion, by the persons who beneficially owned the Company&#8217;s outstanding voting securities immediately prior to such transaction; (ii)&#160;&#160;any transfer, sale or other disposition of all or substantially all of the Company&#8217;s assets on a consolidated basis; or (iii)&#160;&#160;the acquisition, directly or indirectly by any person or related group of persons (other than the Company or a person that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with, the Company), of beneficial ownership (within the meaning of Rule&#160;13d-3 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended) of securities possessing more than fifty percent (50%) of the total combined voting power of the Company's outstanding securities pursuant to a tender or exchange offer made directly to the Company's beneficial holders. &nbsp;In no event, however, shall a Change in Control be deemed to occur in connection with (i)&#160;a merger of the Company, the sole purpose of which is to reincorporate the Company in another jurisdiction, or (ii)&#160;any public offering of Common Stock, the primary &nbsp;</P>
<HR style='border:0;height:0;width:0;margin:14pt 0 0 0'><P align=center style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>7</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#909090;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'>purpose of which is to raise capital; or (iii) an increase or decrease of Executive&#8217;s beneficial ownership in the Company. Executive&#8217;s ability to receive the payment under this Section 10 is conditioned on Executive satisfying the conditions for Severance in Section 9.7(d).</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:36pt'>11.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:72pt></KBD>In no event, however, shall a Change in Control be deemed to occur in connection with (i)&#160;a merger of the Company, the sole purpose of which is to reincorporate the Company in another jurisdiction, or (ii)&#160;any public offering of Common Stock, the primary purpose of which is to raise capital; or (iii) an increase or decrease of Executive&#8217;s beneficial ownership in the Company. Executive&#8217;s ability to receive the payment under this <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Section 10</FONT> is conditioned on Executive satisfying the conditions for Severance in <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Section 9.7(d)</FONT>.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:36pt'>12.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:72pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Miscellaneous</B></FONT>. &nbsp;&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>12.1.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Survival</B></FONT>.  The provisions of <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>Sections 7</FONT>, <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>8</FONT>, <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>9</FONT>, <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>10</FONT>, and <FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'>11</FONT> shall survive the termination of this Agreement.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>12.2.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Modification</B></FONT>. &nbsp;This Agreement may not be modified unless made in writing and signed by the Party against whom the same is sought to be enforced.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>12.3.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Waiver</B></FONT>. &nbsp;Failure of a Party to enforce one or more of the provisions of this Agreement or to require at any time performance of any of the obligations hereof shall not be construed to be a waiver of such provisions by such Party nor to in any way affect the validity of this Agreement or such Party&#8217;s right thereafter to enforce any provision of this Agreement, nor to preclude such Party from taking any other action at any time which it would legally be entitled to take.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>12.4.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Assignment</B></FONT>.  This Agreement and all any rights or obligations hereunder are not assignable by Executive, but may be assigned by the Company upon the sale of substantially all of its assets. &nbsp;&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>12.5.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Notices</B></FONT>. &nbsp;All notices, requests, demands and other communications under this Agreement shall be in writing and transmitted via email, and shall be deemed to have been given at the time of transmittal, as follows:&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-left:36pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:36pt'><B>To the Company:</B></KBD><KBD style=margin-left:144pt></KBD>Qualstar Corporation&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt;text-indent:36pt;margin-left:144pt'>15707 Rockfield Boulevard, Suite 105</P>

<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt;text-indent:36pt;margin-left:144pt'>Attn: &nbsp;David J. Wolenski, Chairman of the Board</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:36pt'><B>To Executive:</B></KBD><KBD style=margin-left:144pt></KBD>Steven N. Bronson&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt;text-indent:36pt;margin-left:144pt'>[redacted]</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>12.6.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Severability</B></FONT>. &nbsp;If any provision of this Agreement is held to be invalid or unenforceable by a court of competent jurisdiction, such invalidity or unenforceability shall not affect the validity and enforceability of the other provisions of this Agreement, and the provision held to be invalid or unenforceable shall be modified so as to be enforced as nearly as possible according to its original terms and intent but only to the extent necessary to eliminate such invalidity or unenforceability.&nbsp;</P>
<HR style='border:0;height:0;width:0;margin:14pt 0 0 0'><P align=center style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>8</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#909090;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>12.7.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Governing Law</B></FONT>. &nbsp;This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California, without regard to its principles of conflict of laws. &nbsp;&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>12.8.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Fees</B></FONT>. In any suit or action brought to enforce this Agreement, or to obtain an adjudication, declaratory or otherwise, of rights hereunder, the losing Party will pay to the prevailing Party reasonable attorneys&#8217; fees and all other costs and expenses that may be incurred by the prevailing Party in such suit or action.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>12.9.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Entire Agreement</B></FONT>. &nbsp;This Agreement sets forth the entire understanding of the Parties relating to Executive&#8217;s employment with the Company and merges and supersedes any prior or contemporaneous agreements between the Parties pertaining to the subject matter hereof. Notwithstanding the foregoing, nothing in this Agreement supersedes or restricts any of Executive&#8217;s existing obligations to the Company or under other agreements between Executive and the Company (including all Executive&#8217;s obligations to the Company to protect the confidentiality of information of the Company and to assign intellectual property rights to it or otherwise protect its intellectual property and/or business interests), all of which remain in full force and effect. &nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:72pt'>12.10.</KBD><KBD style=margin-left:108pt></KBD><FONT style='border-bottom:1px solid #000000'><B>Counterparts</B></FONT>. &nbsp;This Agreement may be executed in any number of counterparts, including facsimile and email with pdf signatures which shall be deemed as original signatures. &nbsp;All executed counterparts shall constitute one agreement, notwithstanding that all signatories are not signatories to the original or the same counterpart.&nbsp;</P>
<HR style='border:0;height:0;width:0;margin:14pt 0 0 0'><P align=center style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>9</P>
